final: WITH acc AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS av FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), reg AS (SELECT region, AVG(av) AS fig FROM acc GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(fig) AS m FROM reg) SELECT reg.region, reg.fig AS figure, reg.fig - overall.m AS excess_over_avg, reg.fig / overall.m AS ratio_to_avg FROM reg, overall WHERE reg.fig > overall.m ORDER BY reg.fig DESC
